records.detail: Algeria names no audit firm for the Banque d'Algerie's own accounts: under section 3 of Loi n. 23-09 of 21 June 2023 relative a la monnaie et au credit, published in Journal Officiel n. 43 of 27 June 2023, oversight of the bank is carried out by a Censorat of two censeurs appointed by presidential decree who must hold central-bank accounting expertise (article 29), and article 30 requires them to report to the board on their verification of the year-end accounts and to send a report to the Minister of Finance within four months of the close of each financial year, the accounts themselves being closed on 31 December under article 31. This is a judgement call recorded on the face of the record: the Censorat is created by the bank own charter law and its members sit in board sessions with a consultative voice, which is close to the pattern the map treats as internal and leaves blank, as with Iran and Macao. It is filed because the censeurs are appointed by presidential decree rather than by the bank, they verify the year-end accounts, and they report to the Minister of Finance within four months of year end, which are the marks of an audit done from outside the bank management. No private firm is named anywhere in the law for the bank own accounts.
records.as_of: Loi 23-09 of 21 June 2023, in force for financial years from 2023
records.source_title: Journal Officiel de la Republique Algerienne n. 43, 27 juin 2023 - Loi n. 23-09 relative a la monnaie et au credit
